turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
Think about last weekend. Maybe you helped someone or cooked a meal. That is the past.
Worked example: "Today I help. Yesterday I helped." The action is finished, so I added -ed.
The rule is: for a regular verb, add -ed to talk about a finished action.
Right: We cooked a big meal. Wrong: We cook a big meal on Saturday night.
Now you try. Write the missing word: "Yesterday my sister ___ (clean) the kitchen."
